scores.evidence: The three can-do objectives each have 2 or more questions with objectiveId. o1 has q1, q2, ps1, ps2 and e1, all apply. o2 has q5, e3 and e4, all analyze. o3 has q3, q4, e5 and e6, apply and analyze, and e6 (`gh pr create`) is a transfer item for 「書ける」. e1 now sets 「長い修正作業を任せます」, so it no longer contradicts q1's plan-mode advice.

hook-lead recalls lesson 1 and poses the problem in three short sentences: 「便利ですが、pushまで知らないうちに進んだら困ります」. The ungraded predict q0 asks what happens to `git push` by default. Its options are now parallel, with no hedging cue (「確認なしで、そのまま実行される」 vs 「確認の画面が出て、あなたの許可を待つ」). It leads straight to o3.

Prerequisites are listed, and hook-lead and rules-task recall lesson 1 and `cc-practice`. Terms are defined before use and match the glossary. auto-lead now ties 「2-1の表で「安全チェック」と呼んだものです」 to 分類器, and e6 glosses `gh`. In auto-defaults, 「force pushや `git reset --hard`」 is still unexplained for a learner who only knows commit and push.

measure.mjs: 「prose 1827 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2476 · practice reading 800 · questions 13 · practice sections 2 · est 19.9 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」, and lint --strict reports 0 warnings. The 2-column tables do not add load. The two-part cells of modes-table (「読み取りだけ。一つずつ確かめる作業」) pack scope and use case together, but each is still one short line. modes (six mode names) and rules (four rule terms) are still the heaviest segments.

rules-example comes before practice-rules. Each example-steps step has a subgoal label (確認か拒否かを決める / ルールの形に書く / 読み込まれたか確かめる), a reason (「pushは中身を見たいので[[確認ルール]]」, 「書いただけでは効いたかわかりません」) and an expect, followed by example-code. p-rule then jumps straight to 「2-4を見ずに」 with no faded step in between.

All five content segments end in an inline apply or analyze quiz with feedback on every wrong option, and answer positions are now balanced. Some items are still cued. In q5 the key is the only option with 「編集ツール」, the word in the table caption. ps2's 「差分を見ながら」 repeats the modes-table cell. e5's key `git -C . push` is the exact string from example-pitfall.

Every misconception in the brief is a distractor, and each feedback corrects it with a reason in 2 sentences or fewer. Examples: q2 a (「分類器も…見逃します（…17%）」), q3 a (「確認ルールが先に調べられます。ルールの広さや書いた順では決まりません」), q4 c and d (deny vs ask, missing `*`), e4 a and b (rewind vs git), e6 d (CLAUDE.md is not enforcement) and e1 b, c, d (short bypass, prompt instructions, approval fatigue). Nothing contradicts anything else any more.

rules-diagram still has 8 nodes, and the only change is a line break in the first label (「Claudeが
操作しようとする」), so caption and alt still match. The new modes-table caption states the point (「モードごとに、確認なしで動く範囲が違う」), and the header 「確認なしで動くものと、向く場面」 tells the reader how to read each two-part cell. rewind-table keeps its takeaway caption, with the examples now in parentheses (「Bashのコマンド（`rm`・`mv`・`cp`）」 → 「戻らない」).

rules-files now puts one command per line, and p-files says 「上のコマンドを1行ずつ実行します」, which makes the setup easier to follow and to debug. The task stays safe (dummy `.env` added to `.gitignore`, no remote) and predict-first, every step has an expect, and rules-prompt gives the success criterion. The transfer item pr-transfer still has no example and no way to check that it worked.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next names the next lesson (第3回｜探索→計画→実装→コミット, which matches the cc-03 title), and there are 7 flashcards and askTutor suggestions. The reflection line 「ほかに確認したい操作を1つ選び、ルールの形で書いてみましょう」 is an action, not a question that makes the learner reflect.

Taking 「v2.1.283以降」 out of modes-table creates no gap: hook-predict still pins the version (「v2.1.283以降、ターミナルとVS Codeの対話セッションはautoモードで始まります（2-1の表）」), which matches cross-lesson fact 1. The new e5 sentence 「Claudeの判断に関係なく止めるフック（hook）は、第8回で学びます」 fits the audit quote 「For a checkpoint that inspects the full command text, add a PreToolUse hook」. The modes-lead doubt from round 1 is still open (niceToHave).

The body is consistently です・ます, warm and non-pressuring (「まず予想してみましょう」, 「大事なリポジトリでは試さないでください」), with no banned phrases. Katakana terms carry the English on first use (分類器（classifier）, チェックポイント（checkpoint）, コンテナ（container）). 安全チェック is now a glossary alias of 分類器. 「リポジトリ（repository）」 first appears inside hidden feedback (q0 b), so q1's prompt is the first visible use.

Validation passes with 0 errors. In rules-diagram, `
` sits only inside the Mermaid label; the caption and alt stay plain text and complete. The plain-text table captions and headers that changed (「モードごとに、確認なしで動く範囲が違う」, 「どうやって変えたか（例）」) contain no markdown, and jp is the only declared locale.

niceToHave: check-quiz e5 explanation (changed): 「Claudeの判断に関係なく」 can be read as if the auto-mode decision were Claude's own, while the sentence before it credits 分類器. A replacement closer to the audit quote: 「コマンド全体の文字列を調べて止めるフック（hook）は、第8回で学びます。」

rules-files / p-files (changed): the chained `&&` is gone. If the learner pastes the whole block and `cd cc-practice` fails, `.env` and `.gitignore` are written in the parent folder. Add to p-files troubleshoot: 「`cd` でエラーが出たら、そこで止め、第1回の手順でフォルダを作ります。」
modes-table (changed): each cell now holds two ideas split by 「。」. A label would make the use case easier to scan, e.g. 「読み取りだけ。向く場面：一つずつ確かめる作業」 (the ja-editor owns the final wording).

Carried from round 1, still open in unchanged blocks: factual doubt (modes-lead) 「6種類あり、作業の途中でも切り替えられます」 vs facts docs-11 (dontAsk is not in the Shift+Tab cycle); auto-defaults gloss for force push / `git reset --hard`; ps2 「差分を見ながら」 matches the modes-table cell word for word; e5's key is the exact string from example-pitfall (an alternative is `git -c push.default=current push origin main`); a faded step before p-rule; a checkable pr-transfer; a reflection question in summary-next.
summary: This is a verification round: review-scope.mjs exited 0 (6 of 41 blocks changed, 9%, with sections and objectives unchanged). Round 1 had no must-fix items, so `resolved` is empty. The six changed blocks have no errors and cause no regression. The tables now have 2 columns with a caption that states the point, the diagram only gained a line break, the setup commands are one per line, and e5's hook sentence is accurate and shorter. I re-scored load, visual, practice, accuracy and a11y_l10n and kept their scores; the other eight are carried over. The mean is 3.31 and the verdict is pass. The best next fixes are the round-1 niceToHave items, starting with the modes-lead doubt about dontAsk.
